key: # Probe core timbres for the beeps (plan v5). Read by audio/build_clips.py.
# key: a ProbeCores.Keys value (src/ProbeCore.cs). Every key must be here once.
# base_hz: pitch of mood note 0, 200 to 3000.
# wave: sine, triangle, square, saw, pulse or fm.
# rhythm: even, swing (long short), stutter (every note twice, quickly) or lazy (longer notes and gaps).
# glide: 0 to 1, how far a note slides in from the pitch of the note before it.
